learning_outcomes.text: The colloquium is to be assessed as an independent examination. It serves to determine whether the candidate is able to orally present and independently justify the scientific topic of the Bachelor's thesis, its technical foundations, its interdisciplinary contexts and its non-technical references, and to assess its practical significance.

syllabus_topics: Content of the thesis according to the topic
Disputation on the approach to preparing the thesis and issues encountered in the context of the work
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module examination. The grade's relevance for the final grade is according to SPO.
